problemType.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
problemType.accessDenied: That request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
problemType.tooManyLoginAttempts: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
problemType.categoryNameAlreadyExists: A category with this name already exists.
problemType.categoryInUse: This category is used by existing transactions, budgets, or recurring templates — reassign them before deleting it.
problemType.builtInCategory: A built-in category cannot be deleted.
problemType.fuelCategory: The dedicated fuel category cannot be renamed or deleted.
problemType.dividendCategory: The dedicated dividend category cannot be renamed or deleted.
problemType.accountNameAlreadyExists: An account with this name already exists.
problemType.accountAlreadyClosed: This account could not be closed: it is already closed, or it is an investment account that still has open products - close those first.
problemType.investmentAccountHasOpenHoldings: This investment account still has open products - close those first.
problemType.accountHasHistory: This account has history (transactions, transfers, recurring templates or investment products) and cannot be deleted - close it instead.
problemType.accountClosed: This account is closed and cannot accept new transactions.
problemType.accountTypeNotAllowed: An investment account cannot be used here.
problemType.vehicleNameAlreadyExists: A vehicle with this name already exists.
problemType.vehicleInUse: This vehicle is used by existing fuel transactions — reassign them before deleting it.
problemType.paymentMethodNameAlreadyExists: A payment method with this name already exists.
problemType.paymentMethodInUse: This payment method is used by existing transactions — reassign them before deleting it.
problemType.institutionNameAlreadyExists: An institution with this name already exists.
problemType.builtInInstitution: The built-in institution cannot be deleted.
problemType.institutionInUse: This institution is still used by an account — move its accounts to another institution before deleting it.
problemType.categoryNotExpense: This category cannot be budgeted - it may already have a budget, or not be an expense category.
problemType.budgetAlreadyExists: This category already has a budget.
problemType.sameAccountTransfer: The two accounts in a transfer must be different.
problemType.invalidTradeConfirmation: Check the trade lines: only one line per product can set a resulting balance, and the net settlement can't be zero.
problemType.investmentTransferInvalid: A trade confirmation's investment side must be an INVESTMENT account and its cash side must not be; a plain transfer can't target an INVESTMENT account at all - use a trade confirmation instead.
problemType.investmentHoldingClosed: Every product in this transfer needs an existing open holding in the investment account.
problemType.investmentCategoryNameAlreadyExists: An investment category with this name already exists.
problemType.investmentCategoryInUse: This category still has sub-categories or is used by an investment product - delete or reclassify those first.
problemType.investmentSubcategoryNameAlreadyExists: This category already has a sub-category with this name.
problemType.investmentSubcategoryInUse: This sub-category is used by an investment product - reclassify those products before deleting it.
problemType.investmentProductNameAlreadyExists: The product could not be saved: its name must already be unique, the account must be an open investment account, and the sub-category must belong to the chosen category.
problemType.investmentAccountRequired: The account must be an open investment account.
problemType.investmentSubcategoryMismatch: The sub-category must belong to the chosen category.
problemType.investmentProductHasHoldings: This product still has a holding (even a closed, empty one) and cannot be deleted - remove its holdings first.
problemType.investmentHoldingAlreadyExists: This holding could not be saved: the account must be an open investment account, and this product already has a holding in it.
problemType.investmentHoldingAlreadyClosed: This holding could not be closed: it is already closed, or its latest snapshot still has value. Record a zero snapshot (or sell the entire position) first.
problemType.investmentHoldingNotEmpty: This holding's latest snapshot still has value - record a zero snapshot (or sell the entire position) first.
problemType.investmentHoldingHasHistory: This holding has history (snapshots or trades) and cannot be deleted - close it instead.
problemType.investmentSnapshotDateTaken: Could not save: another snapshot already has that date, or the holding is closed and this would leave it with a non-zero latest snapshot.
problemType.investmentSnapshotClosedHolding: Could not delete: the holding is closed and its latest snapshot would no longer be zero.
problemType.investmentSegmentNameAlreadyExists: An investment segment with this name already exists.
problemType.investmentSegmentInUse: This segment is still used by an investment product - reclassify it first.
problemType.allocationPlanEntryNotFii: Every entry must be a product classified under the "REITs (FIIs)" sub-category.
problemType.allocationPlanSumInvalid: The entries must sum to exactly 100%.
problemType.allocationPlanDuplicateProduct: The same product cannot appear twice in the allocation plan.

validationCode.digits: This value has too many digits.

validationCode.min: This value is below the allowed minimum.
